content.text:
The bug was in `rb_push` in `src/ringbuf.c`. It wrote to `data[len % cap]` and ignored `head`, so after a pop the ring buffer wrote new values into the wrong slot. I changed the index to `(head + len) % cap`.

`make test` now passes: 118 checks, 0 failures. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
